completion_rule: The program is complete only when every stage is complete and at least two genuine transfer cases pass the preregistered control/joint-outcome gates without holdout refitting.

stages.name: nepal_development_and_falsification
remaining: Do not reinterpret the zero-recorded-contact result as a successful violence reconstruction.

stages.name: afghanistan_first_transfer
remaining: Do not tune the failed transfer. The v2 target ensemble is superseded by the live v3 core; rerun the predeclared target gate against v3 before treating the failure as current-core evidence. The prospective control operator still requires a new predeclared run and cannot rescore discarded v1 vector state.

stages.name: comparative_case_ladder
remaining: Complete heterogeneous control/presence joins and measurement panels for Colombia, Iraq, and Vietnam; direct-source gaps and explicit not-reported intervals remain run blockers; then run frozen holdouts.

stages.name: theory_extraction
remaining: Replicate mechanism directions in at least two transfer cases and satisfy every survival criterion; the synthetic recovery battery licenses estimands only, not a general mechanism claim.

stages.name: simple_competitor_and_reduced_model_tests
remaining: Acquire and harmonize pre-target longitudinal control observations, then run the implemented training-only control competitors; never use the October 2017 target mean as training.

stages.name: coin_science
remaining: No efficacy claim until two transfer cases pass control/joint-outcome gates.

stages.name: research_program_artifact
remaining: Complete comparative evidence, theory extraction, and falsifiable COIN implications before claiming resolution.
